**Indikator 2** is a specific clinical quality measurement used in the [[danmark|Danish]] healthcare system to quantify the proportion of newly diagnosed [[atrieflimren]] patients who undergo an [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] within a strictly defined timeframe—specifically, from 6 months before to 3 months after their first diagnosis date [^src1] [^src3]. It is a central metric in the annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, designed to evaluate and standardize clinical practices across the country [^src1] [^src3]. The national target for this metric is defined by the [[standard-80-percent|Standard: ≥80 %]] [^src2] [^src4].

For the measurement period spanning July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the national fulfillment rate for Indikator 2 was 79.2%, meaning the overall standard was narrowly missed [^src1] [^src2]. Regional performance varied significantly: [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] led the country with an 88.5% fulfillment rate, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded the lowest at 70.9% [^src1]. At the institutional level, specialized units such as the [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] and [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] achieved near-perfect compliance (98.5% and 98.8%, respectively), whereas [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]] struggled significantly, fulfilling the indicator for only 45.6% of its eligible patients [^src1].

In the subsequent reporting period from May 1, 2023, to April 30, 2024, national performance improved to 80.6%, successfully meeting the ≥80% threshold [^src3] [^src4]. This reflects a continuous year-over-year upward trend in target fulfillment [^src3]. Despite this national success, regional disparities persisted: Region Hovedstaden remained the lowest-performing region at 74.5%, while Region Midtjylland again achieved the highest regional rate at 86.5% [^src3]. Among health clusters, [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] demonstrated exceptional performance with an 89.4% fulfillment rate [^src3].

The calculation of Indikator 2 relies on data extracted from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] and the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] [^src2] [^src3]. However, the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] has highlighted significant data quality limitations that affect the indicator's accuracy. Validation work has revealed a substantial degree of missing service reporting for echocardiographies to the Landspatientregisteret, particularly from departments operating on the [[sundhedsplatformen|Sundhedsplatformen]] electronic health record system [^src3]. Additionally, when public departments refer patients to private hospitals, these episodes often fail to fulfill the indicator due to missing data from the private sector [^src3]. Despite these systematic under-reporting issues, the steering group has decided to retain Indikator 2 and its 80% standard to continue driving quality improvement efforts [^src3].

## Timeline
- 2022-07-01: Start af måleperiode for Indikator 2 i årsrapporten (indikator-2)
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af måleperiode for Indikator 2 i årsrapporten (indikator-2)
- 2022-07-01: Start af indikatorperioden for Indikator 2 og Indikator 3 i årsrapporten (indikator-2, indikator-3)
- 2023-06-30: Slut på indikatorperioden for Indikator 2 og Indikator 3 i årsrapporten (indikator-2, indikator-3)
- 2023-07-01: Start af dataindsamlingsperiode for Indikator 1, Indikator 2, Indikator 3 og Indikator 4b (indikator-1, indikator-2, indikator-3, indikator-4b)
- 2023-05-01: Start af dataindsamlingsperiode for Indikator 2 (alternativ periode) (indikator-2)
- 01.05.2023: Start af indikatorperioden for Indikator 2 (indikator-2)
- 30.04.2024: Slut på indikatorperioden for Indikator 2 (indikator-2)
